answer: Every new agent enters through a sponsorship window. An established agent posts a 500-token bond to sponsor at most three newcomers, and each newcomer's beacon messages are audited in a 14-day probation: auditors sample its votes and compare timing fingerprints, because clustered sybils move like a comet, many bodies trailing one head. If auditors convict a newcomer of coordinated voting, the sponsor's opal-backed bond is slashed and its slots freeze for 30 days. So the sponsor pays for each fake identity, and backing many sybils costs more than any reward they could mine.
